name: al-Mughnī
author: Ibn Qudāma al-Maqdisī
authorArabic: موفق الدين عبد الله بن أحمد بن قدامة المقدسي
about: The commentary on al-Khiraqī's Mukhtaṣar that became the Ḥanbalī school's great reference, setting each question against the other schools with its proofs.

name: al-Mubdiʿ fī sharḥ al-Muqniʿ
nameEnglish: The Originator, a Commentary on al-Muqniʿ
author: Burhān al-Dīn Ibn Mufliḥ
authorArabic: برهان الدين إبراهيم بن محمد بن مفلح
about: The commentary on Ibn Qudāma's al-Muqniʿ, with the later Ḥanbalī positions and their proofs.

name: al-Itqān fī ʿulūm al-Qurʾān
nameEnglish: Mastery in the Sciences of the Qurʾān
author: Jalāl al-Dīn al-Suyūṭī
authorArabic: جلال الدين عبد الرحمن بن أبي بكر السيوطي
about: Cited for its account of which routes of tafsir from Ibn ʿAbbās are weak, and why.
